analysis.insight_summary: The user had trouble determining if their hardware was compatible with the current software version of [product_name] modules. There was some initial confusion regarding the need to update [product_name] to ensure compatibility with the hardware's article number and version. Although installation was challenging at first, the user eventually managed to install the upgrade and achieve successful operation. The onboarding and upgrade process was hindered by installation problems and the detection of a demo version.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an effortless way to identify compatible software for specific [product_name] hardware, as well as a straightforward and error-free upgrade experience. Clear instructions for resolving installation issues are desired.
